findings.title: Spoofable x-vercel-isr header re-enables unauthenticated path override on all functions
findings.suggested_fix: Do not rely on a bare client-controllable header. Assumption: Vercel does not guarantee stripping of x-vercel-isr on external requests. Either (a) bake an `isr` boolean into virtual:astro-vercel:config only for the `_isr` function build, so `_render` never honors the query param (e.g. `else if (isrEnabledForThisFunction && request.headers.get('x-vercel-isr') === '1')`), and/or (b) add a build-time ISR secret via prerender-config/route `headers` or the route `dest` rewrite and compare it as is done for middlewareSecret. Add tests to path-override-security.test.js: `_render` with `x-vercel-isr: 1` + `x_astro_path` must ignore the param, and `_isr` must honor it. If Vercel documents x-vercel-isr as platform-owned and always overwritten on ingress, cite it in a comment and downgrade this.

residual_risks: Assumes Vercel does not strip/overwrite a client-supplied x-vercel-isr header and that x-vercel-isr: 1 is actually set on ISR invocations; neither could be verified offline (the PR notes only a manual e2e).

On the _isr path, the rewrite ignores edge middleware (ISR routes dest to ISR_PATH, not MIDDLEWARE_PATH), so any attacker able to make the ISR function render an arbitrary x_astro_path (cache-key poisoning via allowQuery) reaches routes without middleware; this is pre-#15959 behavior but not mitigated by the new gate.
testing_gaps: No test exercises the new x-vercel-isr branch: neither that _isr honors x_astro_path with x-vercel-isr: 1, nor that _render (and _isr without the header) still ignores it. path-override-security.test.js should gain both cases so the #15959 guarantee is pinned.

findings.title: Path override re-opened via client-suppliable x-vercel-isr header on every function (CWE-290, A01)
findings.suggested_fix: Narrow the trust. (1) Pass an `isr` boolean through `virtual:astro-vercel:config` (vite-plugin-config.ts) and only honor the query param when ISR is enabled for this build. (2) Prefer scoping it to the ISR function itself, for example by building `_isr` with its own entrypoint or flag so `_render` never honors the param. (3) If a platform-set secret exists for ISR invocations (Vercel's bypassToken or an ISR-specific secret like the one removed in #15959's 'remove ISR secret plumbing'), compare against that instead of the bare `x-vercel-isr` header. Assumption: Vercel does not guarantee stripping of client-sent `x-vercel-isr`; if it does, (1) alone is a cheap reduction of exposure.

residual_risks: The change depends on Vercel's unverified behavior: that `x-vercel-isr: 1` is set only by the platform on ISR invocations and stripped or overwritten on external requests. This was not verifiable offline (no network access), so the finding is anchored at 50.

The `x-vercel-isr` header name is not defined anywhere in the repo and is not mentioned in the existing 'isn't documented by vercel anywhere' ISR comment in src/index.ts, so a platform change would silently re-break ISR with a 404.
testing_gaps: No test for the new branch: nothing asserts that a request with x-vercel-isr: 1 and ?x_astro_path=... rewrites the path, and nothing asserts that the param is still ignored without the header or on a non-ISR build. Both could be added to test/path-override-security.test.js using the loadFunctionModule helper there.
No test asserts that `_render` (as opposed to `_isr`) ignores x-vercel-isr: 1 plus x_astro_path.

findings.title: Spoofable x-vercel-isr header re-enables query-param path override on every function
findings.suggested_fix: Add an `isr` boolean to the virtual:astro-vercel:config module (createConfigPlugin in src/index.ts), and have the ISR entry build (buildISRFolder for '_isr') set it; only evaluate the x-vercel-isr/x_astro_path branch when that flag is true, so _render and non-ISR builds never honor the query param. Also confirm with Vercel that x-vercel-isr is injected platform-side and stripped from client requests; if not, pair it with a trusted signal (e.g. a secret bypassToken-style check) instead. Assumption: x-vercel-isr is set by the platform on prerender-function invocations.

residual_risks: Assumes Vercel sets x-vercel-isr on ISR prerender-function invocations and strips or overwrites it on client requests; not verifiable offline, and the fix has only been checked manually against a test project.
Direct client requests to /_isr?x_astro_path=... or /_render are reachable via Vercel's filesystem handler; whether x-vercel-isr can be client-supplied there is the crux of the P0 concern.
testing_gaps: No test covers the new ISR branch: neither that x-vercel-isr: 1 plus x_astro_path rewrites on the _isr function, nor that x_astro_path stays ignored on _render and non-ISR builds when x-vercel-isr: 1 is sent. Adding the positive and negative cases next to test/path-override-security.test.js would catch a future regression of either #15959 or this fix.

findings.title: New x-vercel-isr path-rewrite branch has no test
findings.suggested_fix: Extend packages/integrations/vercel/test/path-override-security.test.js (reusing loadFunctionModule and the dynamic-routes fixture) with: (1) positive: Request('https://example.com/_isr?x_astro_path=/api/private', {headers: {'x-vercel-isr': '1'}}) returns the /api/private body (or build the isr fixture and load the _isr function); (2) negative: same URL without the header, and with 'x-vercel-isr': '0', still resolves the real URL path; (3) valid middleware secret still takes precedence over the ISR param. Assumption: the dynamic-routes fixture needs ISR enabled or the test targets the isr fixture's _isr function.

residual_risks: The new gate is solely request.headers.get('x-vercel-isr') === '1', which the entrypoint does not authenticate; whether an external client can spoof it on the _render function depends on Vercel platform header stripping, which could not be verified here. No test pins the assumption.
testing_gaps: No test covers precedence when both a valid middleware secret and x-vercel-isr: 1 are present.
No test checks that an x-vercel-isr value other than '1' (e.g. 'true', '0') is rejected.

findings.title: New realPath block fails Biome formatting required by AGENTS.md
findings.suggested_fix: Run `pnpm format` (or `biome format --write`) on the file: `if (hasValidMiddlewareSecret) {`, `realPath = request.headers.get(ASTRO_PATH_HEADER);`, `} else if (request.headers.get('x-vercel-isr') === '1') {`.
